name: ProcessPlantShiftLogbook
tagline: The control-room shift logbook for mineral processing plants – throughput, setpoints, alarms and a signed handover in one Power Apps component.
description: Complete operator shift logbook app for concentrators and processing plants: hourly throughput per circuit against target, setpoint changes with second-person authorisation, alarms that must be acknowledged before closing, equipment downtime, an actions board and a signed shift handover with carry-forward items. Works in Canvas and Model-driven apps with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Throughput vs target per circuit with sparkline and % of target chart
Setpoint change limit with authorisation and segregation of duties
Signed handover with carry-forward and summary text
Bulk actions with rule checks and Undo
Low-code column mapping and Power Fx events
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
